phase: sealed before repair implementation or supplemental execution

modes.binding: Exact required bits, not inferred from the mutable stat under test; no chmod/umask repair. Source-member modes remain independently sealed source bindings. All paths remain canonical/no-symlink.

lateAdmission: Check after authentication, after attempt persistence and final authentication immediately before start. >=whole deadline refuses. >=row TERM admission boundary refuses. A start that returns late remains a real attempted/submitted launch with failure, never rewritten as unexecuted.
completion: Successful rows require submitted positive PID, observed spawn then exit and close, absent group, no fault. Inconsistent completion refuses without inventing missing observations. Ordinary nonzero remains neutral.
dataPolicy: Exact finite own data; reject holes/accessors/extras without coercion; prototype identity is not authority. Direct validation throws retain exact reason; captured failures retain original reasons in nonserialized in-memory records. No hostile-JS sandbox claim.

controlDetails.fourOriginalModeCases: Same bytes, changed observed mode; fail before start or at final validation. Actual correct mode passes in all positive model cases.
controlDetails.directoryAndReceiptModes: Fail closed and preserve tracked ownership, including post-publication mode changes; no unbound deletion.
controlDetails.second-row-mode-change: After first completed modeled row, changed mode prevents second start and preserves first launch/close.
controlDetails.just-before-final-admission-boundary: 149999 virtual ms, synchronous zero-delay modeled natural completion, admitted once; exact150000 rejects.
controlDetails.deadline-crossed-during-start: Start called while admitted but returns at deadline; preserve submitted PID and actual spawn/close, refuse success.
controlDetails.spawn-after-terminal: Delayed spawn/exit/close cannot change a reported terminal-uncertain outcome or retroactively increment launches.
controlDetails.prototype-distinct-own-data: Own-data records/arrays with different or null prototypes accepted; no VM/engine imported, so not an actual cross-realm execution claim.
controlDetails.accessor-no-coercion: Config and role accessors rejected using descriptors; getter counters stay zero.
controlDetails.array-hole-and-extra-rejection: Hole, extra string/symbol property, inherited replacement index, nonfinite numeric value refused.
controlDetails.own-data-trap-reason-identity: A descriptor/ownKeys trap throwing a sentinel must escape validation as that same value.
controlDetails.captured-falsy-reason-identity: undefined/null/false/0/empty string/symbol/object failures retained by identity in memory; safe bounded JSON summaries cannot replace original reasons.
controlDetails.config-toJSON-not-executed: Snapshotting does not invoke toJSON or any accessor before admission.
